response.text: The dictionary largely matches the data, but I see a few discrepancies to verify: no VOID invoices exist despite the dictionary listing V; no unposted journals (U) despite the listed code; APVEND has no inactive vendors; and the notes say "Name of the user" for SRC_REF but the data may differ. I'll check a few more things: payment vs invoice totals, the AP-to-GL link, and whether the SYSDICT covers all columns.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'undocumented_cols' k, COUNT(*)::text v FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema='public' AND c.table_name<>'SYSDICT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SYSDICT" d WHERE d."TBL_NM"=c.table_name AND d."COL_NM"=c.column_name) UNION ALL SELECT 'AP_inv_jrnl_not_in_GLJRNH', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'AP_jrnl_src_not_AP', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."SRC_CD"<>'AP' UNION ALL SELECT 'AP_inv_status_O_with_payments', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'AP_inv_status_P_without_payments', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'P_fully_paid_mismatch', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='P' AND i."INV_AMT"<>(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'JRNL_periods_not_in_GLPERD', COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'JRNL_post_dt_outside_period', COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" UNION ALL SELECT 'JRNL_line_dr_cr_zero', COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"=0 AND "CR_AMT"=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'JRNL_no_lines', COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'unbalanced_journals', COUNT(*)::text FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT")<>SUM("CR_AMT")) x UNION ALL SELECT 'INV_date_bad_fmt', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_DT" NOT BETWEEN 19000101 AND 29991231 UNION ALL SELECT 'sample_memo', MIN("MEMO") FROM "GLJRNH";
